intro: Across 12 articles published between 14 April and 9 October 2026, ZCyberNews tracked extortion activity tied to ShinyHunters and BlackFile. Coverage centered on CVE-2026-35273, alongside the wider campaigns these actors pursued. Education and government featured most often among affected sectors, with law enforcement, cryptocurrency, and education also appearing. Incidents spanned North america, Global, United states, Canada, and Jordan. Severity skewed heavily toward high ratings, with 11 of the 12 articles rated high and one medium. The archive below collects that reporting in full.
